value.rationale: The precise cd=b threshold distinguishes universal global convergence in an unbounded infinite-equilibrium phase space from loss of universal relaxation; immediately above it, an infinite symmetry lattice of stable cycles is born. A new exact Lyapunov function proves the difficult endpoint, and a model-specific amplitude law and vanishing first-order frequency drift create a quantitative dynamical calibration. The strict period bound is sharp. This is a motivated complete natural phase boundary, not a routine local numerical improvement.
